name.description: What the change is called: one line of 1 to 100 characters. It is written last, from the prompt and every answer.

prompt.description: What the person asked for, in 1 to 4,000 characters: as typed, or put into better words by the assistant with nothing added. It may be a line, a need or a full brief.

given.description: What the person answered when asked, each answer put into one line of 1 to 300 characters by the assistant: 1 to 10 lines, none twice. Nothing the prompt says already, and nothing the person did not say. Left out when nothing was asked.

description: The input of a change: the prompt a person gave, what they answered when asked, and a name written last. It names no record that is not there yet.
